name: creator-support
description: Mobile-first social media support platform for rural creators.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @creator-support/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w apps/api"
